subject: Miko997
purpose: Select relevant, demonstrably accepted upstream work for a simulation, robotics and research-software profile.
selection_method: Rank verified substantive work by professional relevance and demonstrated scope; stars and raw line counts are not ranking criteria. Six tiles cover four project families, with ROS 2 core, RViz and ROS Perception deliberately identified as related projects.
privacy: Read-only authenticated public GitHub searches and direct reads of identified public repositories. No private enumeration, credentials, author email addresses, raw issue bodies or source patches retained in this report.

coverage.verification: All 15 PR detail and files endpoints checked: repository public, author Miko997, merged true, draft false; file pagination matched changed_files.

coverage.reviewed: All 13 issue bodies; all comments of 5 BlenDaViz issues and timeline of weitsicht #8.
All four PR review endpoints, paginated at 100; all inline comments of Newton #3898.
Eight technical PRs and two own-package feedstock release PRs; all substantive Miko997 comments on the six PRs beyond formal-review search were read.
Detailed comments read for 10 selected review/technical issues; two JOSS pre-review threads and OpenUSD issue #4220 not exhaustively read.
21 canonical commit rows, 8 identical-SHA mirror duplicates excluded; each canonical commit queried via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/pulls with per_page=100, all responses under 100.

selected_showcase.contribution: GPU benchmarks for full and partial simulation resets
selected_showcase.selection_reason: Strongest breadth in the audit: physics-format correctness, USD collision integration, robust asset acquisition and reproducible GPU simulation benchmarking. The representative benchmark is a substantive simulation/research-software contribution.

selected_showcase.contribution: URDF inertia regression coverage across recompilation and XML round trips
selected_showcase.selection_reason: Verified authored C++ regression work directly checks physical inertia semantics across recompilation and XML round trips. Its exact code is accepted upstream even though another person authored the containing PR.

selected_showcase.contribution: Hydra scene-index prefixing for absolute and membership path expressions
selected_showcase.selection_reason: Verified authored Hydra scene-index implementation and tests are relevant to scene composition and digital-twin tooling. Upstream bot integration supplies accepted-code evidence despite the original PR being closed without GitHub merge.
Wait-set ownership and executor lifecycle fixes demonstrate systems-level robotics integration. Other merged ROS 2 client, code-generation and CLI work is grouped under this core project identity.

selected_showcase.contribution: Keyboard event routing after native render-window interaction
selected_showcase.selection_reason: A recognizable robotics visualization project with an actual native-window/Qt event-routing fix and regression tests. It is explicitly a ROS-family project, not an additional independent foundation.

selected_showcase.contribution: Caller transport defaults and existing parameter declarations
selected_showcase.selection_reason: Point-cloud transport defaults and parameter lifecycle behavior are directly relevant to robotics perception pipelines. This is the ros-perception project family, not a claim of ownership or maintainership.

limits: Search completeness means all items returned by these exact queries were obtained (one page below 100 and incomplete_results=false), not all historical public activity or all commits ever authored.

Search indexing, linked GitHub author identity, branch reachability, and mirror duplication constrain commit coverage. Public repositories owned by Miko997 are intentionally excluded from the upstream commit search.
The reviewed-by search covers formal PR review records; informal review comments required a separate commenter query. Neither query alone supports an exhaustive historical-review claim.

All 21 unique canonical commit search hits have a PR association; no additional independent direct-to-default-branch contribution was established. OpenUSD is separately verified as maintainer integration of a closed-unmerged source PR.
The two ancestry checks prove the exact landed commits are ancestors of the captured default branch tips; they do not prove release availability or that every line remains unchanged at current tip.
Review test results are the author’s publicly reported validation and maintainer replies, not tests rerun during this audit.
Merged-PR search returns all 15 items from this exact public upstream query at the audit date; complete API pagination does not guarantee perfect GitHub historical indexing.
The two accepted commits are additional evidence types, not two additional authored merged PRs. Contribution totals and streaks continue to come solely from the GitHub calendar.
Open or draft submissions, unverified affiliations and code merely present in a personal fork do not qualify for the showcase.
No source or test changes were executed in upstream projects during this audit. PR/commit diffs and public review records are evidence of contribution scope, not independent performance benchmarking.
